title: Isaiah 27
paragraphs: ¹ In that day, the LORD will punish with his sword — his fierce, great and powerful sword — Leviathan the gliding serpent, Leviathan the coiling serpent; he will slay the monster of the sea. ² In that day — "Sing about a fruitful vineyard: ³ I, the LORD, watch over it; I water it continually. I guard it day and night so that no one may harm it. ⁴ I am not angry. If only there were briers and thorns confronting me! I would march against them in battle; I would set them all on fire. ⁵ Or else let them come to me for refuge; let them make peace with me, yes, let them make peace with me."

⁶ In days to come, Jacob will take root, Israel will bud and blossom and fill all the world with fruit. ⁷ Has the LORD struck her as he struck down those who struck her? Has she been killed as those were killed who killed her?

¹¹ When its branches wither they will be broken off, and women will come and burn them in the fire. This is a people without understanding — so the one who made them will show them no compassion, and the one who formed them will show them no favor. ¹² In that day the LORD will thresh the grain from the Euphrates River to the Wadi of Egypt, and you, Israel's children, will be gathered one by one. ¹³ And in that day a great trumpet will sound. Those who were perishing in Assyria and those who were exiled in Egypt will come and worship the LORD on the holy mountain at Jerusalem.
